caveats: One instrumented build per stage; existing native tests overlapped; no census timings are performance evidence.
Unused means zero local SSA operand references in the final pre-LLVM snapshot, not a general safe-deletion proof.
Root attribution recognizes mut/reload load names. Other loads remain unattributed.
Storage events count emitted lane stores, not runtime copy executions; other store paths are not included.
Type groups use semantic spelling, MIR kind, and lane width; Effect environments with different concrete captures may share a group.
